Frequently asked questions

[travel-icon] Where are the lessons held in Coventry?

[location-icon] Lessons run at a central Coventry venue with free parking, a short walk from the station.

[calendar-icon] How many weeks does the beginners course last?

The beginners course runs for three weekly evening classes, each two hours long, with notes after every class.

[camera-icon]Which camera do I need to bring along?

Any camera with manual settings works: a DSLR, a mirrorless camera or a bridge camera with full manual mode.
